prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite atlas for an existing 2D side scrolling Journey to the West Heavenly Palace game. Create ONE wide landscape sheet 1536x1024 divided into FOUR equal invisible cells (2 columns, 2 rows), ample transparent gutters, no visible grid, no text, no labels, no background color, genuine alpha transparency including the gate opening. Match the ornate hand-painted semi-realistic Chinese fantasy game art, warm gold / ivory jade / blue silk of the reference images. Reference 1 locks the giant guardian identity: same silver and gold lion armor, blue cape, white plume, beard, two arms and two legs; reference 2 supplies architecture style only, do not copy the full scenery.
TOP LEFT cell (x0..768,y0..512): one beautiful adult celestial fairy flying toward the RIGHT in a graceful horizontal three-quarter profile, flowing cream and soft peach-pink hanfu with long fluttering ribbons trailing left. Clearly visible head, both arms and feet, both hands together extended toward the right, palms EMPTY and cupped to carry a single peach added by code. No peach in this cell. Complete silhouette within this cell, no cropped ribbons.
TOP RIGHT cell (x768..1536,y0..512): one isolated elegant Heavenly Palace passage gate, frontal view, compact width and tall arched doorway. Ivory white jade frame, carved auspicious cloud ornament, small red lacquer pillars and refined gold trim with a small traditional green-gold upturned roof. Wide EMPTY TRANSPARENT arched opening takes up most of interior. White jade threshold and a few wisps of cloud at the feet. No rectangular dark hole, no black background, no scenery behind the opening, no lettering. Complete gate within cell.
BOTTOM LEFT cell (x0..768,y512..1024): ONE defeated giant guardian matching reference 1, lying horizontally on his side on the ground, head to LEFT and boots to RIGHT, blue cape resting under body, both arms clearly present, knees relaxed and bent, one forearm braced gently near his face, other arm over torso, dropped gold axe lying alongside. Full body all contained, dignified unconscious defeat, no blood, not standing and not flattened. Has substantial armored chest and leg volume, painted perspective of a side scrolling game, no ground or shadow plate, transparent outside silhouette.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell (x768..1536,y512..1024): ONE large ripe heavenly longevity peach cutout, plump heart shaped pink/ivory/golden skin, visible peach cleft and green leaves with a short brown stem. Clean easily recognizable silhouette, no bowl, no fairy, no lettering, no surrounding objects.
All four cutouts have crisp anti-aliased edges and no matte or colored rectangles. Do not merge the four subjects. This is an atlas of separate reusable sprites, NOT a scene or poster.
